articles.summary: CHICAGO, Aug. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance, Inc. (NASDAQ: REFI, “Chicago Atlantic”, "REFI" or the “Company”), a commercial mortgage real estate investment trust, today announced its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
articles.title: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
